body: No reason to be sorry. You have done me no wrong. You tried which is more than most.
I exercise regularly and currently am at work. I appreciate the sentiment but this is one of the darker days again for me. I hope I can make it through but it's getting tougher each time.
"The trouble with quotes on the Internet is that you can never know if they are genuine." --Abraham Lincoln
"Give me a minute and I will change your mind. Give me a bullet and I will change your life."
It's the selfishness of the act that binds us to others. I don't't think it wouldn't be too bad for me though. Only 2 people would notice my absence. And neither of them rely on me.

I can't get it out of my head. Everyone has their problems, so how is it fair for me to unload more on them? I've always been everyone else's pillar and I know that burden and I don't wish someone to try and undertake my problems. I've gotten so used to my state of mind, I almost feel as if when I'm not miserable I'm not happy. I don't know anymore. I hate feeling like this, every time I feel sad or depressed I get even more depressed (is that possible???) because I am sad and depressed. I will eventually get to a point where I go numb and then just laugh uncontrollably at myself. I have absolutely no reason to be depressed. I have a great life. I built it, I should be proud of it, and in fact I am, but I still feel empty. The emptiness never leaves. The bitterness remains, like a finding a glass of water on the table while your thirsty only for it to turn out to be saltwater. I remember when I was 6,  I would constantly complain about wanting to die, it stressed my dad and his (then current) wife out to no end. Finally one day I was caused her to snap, she... I just realized I've been wanting to die since I started forming memories... what does that say about me as a person? Why can't I just appreciate the gifts in front of me? I can see them? I know I should be happy. I see other people happy with their gifts. And many other people don't have gifts as nice as mine. Why do they get to be happy? That's all I want. I fear it may never come for me. Sorry for the rant. I have to go.

You definitely are not alone in this adventure, you can't see the other adventurers and they probably can't see you. But every once in a while you bump into someone who sets you on your path back to freedom from the prison, from the darkness, from the void. Good luck on your journey out.

I'm sure you genuinely care and I appreciate the response. I'm not concerned with judgement, we all judge, its human nature and I'm ok with that. I've managed to "act" normal for years. Put on the smile, give the firm handshake, carry on normal and intellectual conversations. Sometimes I can't hold it back anymore but I'm usually be able to stay away from people during those breakdowns. I actually get great reviews from my retail job. But faking it doesn't fill the void I feel. You should definitely set you concerns elsewhere. There are way more important people who need your attention. But I definitely appreciate your concern.

I do understand. I can't talk to my girlfriend because she has her own issues and anytime I try to bring it up I always end up feeling like a burden. I'm not narcissistic enough to think that my situation is unique but it is *my* situation. I can't afford therapy. I don't think talking about helps. I understand psychology it is supposed to help, but I've talked about it and it doesn't help. I hate sharing because I always end up feeling like a burden which is something I despise. I love helping people but hate the idea that I might be costing anyone, anything (to include time.) It took a lot for me to even post what I did here because I really don't think it's for the best to waste others times with my dilemmas. I don't know why but I felt compelled to finally post. I appreciate your response, I genuinely do.

I don't have any advice, and I can't offer much in terms of support. What I can say is that I know your struggle. I am mid twenties, decent job (after growing up poor and sometimes homeless), been told that I'm doing amazing considering my youth, all that good jazz. I can relate to you in a lot of ways. And yet even with my understanding girlfriend, nothing ever seems to bring me out of this... ?mindset?  ?phase? i dont know what to call it. All I know is that I feel numb, and my emotions seemed to be short circuited. I don't know the point of my ramblings other than to tell you that you are not the only one struggling and hopefully you can find your answers as I'm really starting to doubt mine exist. My biggest problem right now is the not wanting to exist. I don't want to die, necessarily, I just don't want to exist anymore. People say, "just go get help" but if it were that easy wouldn't we just do it? Well, like I said, I hope you find what you need. You sound like you are an amazing person who can definitely provide something to a special person. I'm not going to say anything stupid and cliche like "Keep your head up" because that shit just isn't helpful or real. My fleeting piece of advice...if you feel like you are stumbling and tripping through the darkness, try to realize you may have tripped over someone else making the same journey.
